paragraphs: Comtech works on mission-critical communications systems that underpin public safety, global security, supply chains and public infrastructure. Its Satellite and Space Communications segment supplies secure, all-domain communications solutions for military missions. Allerium, formerly the Terrestrial and Wireless Networks segment, sells what the company calls dependable, life-saving solutions to public safety professionals.

On the public safety side, its equipment connects originating service providers and public safety answering points, the centers known as PSAPs. The company has announced Allerium Mira, a cloud-native call handling platform for NG9-1-1. It also offers Global Navigation Satellite Systems reference data feeds for location-based products and services. Its wireless portfolio includes end-to-end SMSC and Wireless Emergency Alerts solutions.

The business began as Comtech Laboratories, Inc., founded in 1967 in Smithtown, New York. It is now headquartered in Chandler, Arizona. Ken Traub is listed as chairman, president and chief executive officer. The company has announced a definitive agreement to sell most of its satellite and space communications business to Gilat.
